articles:
We all knew Taylor Swift’s London shows for the Eras Tour were going to be epic but her three-night stint at Wembley was beyond our wildest dreams.

From the Sir Paul McCartney dancing to But Daddy, I Love Him to Travis Kelce getting on stage in a top hat for a whole routine, it’s been one for the history books.

The list of celebrities attending across the weekend was almost as long as the mammoth three-and-a-half-hour setlist and included actual royalty for Prince William’s birthday.

Taylor decided to shake off Dave Grohl’s not-so-subtle dig and put on three of her most unhinged shows of the entire tour for the 89,000 people (per night) watching.

This was only the first round as the 35-year-old superstar will return to London for five more shows in August – possibly by then Reputation TV will have finally been announced.

There’s no denying Taylor wanted fans to ‘remember this moment’ so here are the most bonkers moments from London nights one, two, and three.

Travis Kelce’s surprise stage debut

Talk about hard launching your partner, Taylor Swift’s boyfriend Travis, 34, took to the stage at London night three for her Tortured Poets Department set.

The NFL star appeared with dancers Kam and Jan in a top hat and tuxedo as she changed from her iconic cream dress into I Can Do It With A Broken Heart set.

Travis beamed as he pretended to apply makeup to Taylor’s face during the skit, which sees the So High School singer pretending she doesn’t want to perform.

In one dramatic moment, the Kansas City Chiefs tight end picked up his girlfriend and carried her across the stage with the fans absolutely losing their minds.

In another sweet moment, Taylor blows a kiss to Travis, who blushes as he disappears from the stage.

The pair had been grinning and waving at each other all weekend, with ‘Travvy’ hosting in the VIP tent but his Eras Tour debut was the cherry on top.

Prince William shakes it off

We’ve all seen Taylor’s Instagram post by now, which is a selfie with the king of her heart as well as the future king of England.

‘Happy Bday M8! London shows are off to a splendid start,’ Taylor wrote after Prince William attended her Friday night show for his 42nd birthday celebrations.

The Prince of Wales had brought Prince George and Princess Charlotte with him, however, Kate Middleton and little Prince Louis did not attend.

While the selfie was wild, it was a fan video of the future king dancing which sent fans into meltdown.

The camera pans from the stage up to the royal box, where Wills can be seen dancing his heart out to Shake It Off.

After his dad dancing went viral, Prince William wrote on X: ‘Thank you @taylorswift13 for a great evening!’

Sir Paul McCartney gets into Swiftiemania

Legendary Sir Paul McCartney didn’t just attend the Eras Tour, he was up and dancing with fans too.

The Beatles star got out and about, trading friendship bracelets with Swifties and even stopping to dance with a group.

Leaving the shelter of the (jam-packed) VIP tent, the 82-year-old singer was filmed dancing to one of Taylor’s newest hits But Daddy I Love Him in the crowd.

As fan @rubii_leal wrote on X: ‘Paul McCartney really lived through the Beatlemania and now he has experienced the Swiftie-mania 6 decades later.’

Sir Paul and Taylor have been friends for a while now and were even paired together for Rolling Stone’s Musicians on Musicians in 2020.

She said at the time: ‘The times that I’ve run into you, I correlate with being some of the most fun nights of my life. I was at a party with you when everybody just started playing music.

‘And it was Dave Grohl playing, I was playing his song called “Best of You,” but I was playing it on piano, and he didn’t recognize it until about halfway through.’

The Foo Fighters frontman would later call Taylor ‘Batman’, explaining she swooped in and saved him as he was struggling to play while ‘high’.

Tom Cruise trades friendship bracelets

The VIP tent didn’t stop with Sir Paul as Hollywood heavyweight Tom Cruise was also in attendance.

He danced the night away with Misson Impossible director Christopher McQuarrie, attending both Saturday and Sunday’s gigs.

The 61-year-old actor could be seen grinning as he and the entire VIP tent jumped to Shake It Off – clearly a celeb favourite.

At one point Travis put his hands on Tom’s shoulders and the pair shared a delighted exchange, both absolutely beaming over the performance.

As is customary at the Eras Tour, the Top Gun legend swapped friendship bracelets with those in the crowd.

One Swiftie posted a video saying she was excited to tell him her favourite film was Vanilla Sky, a 2001 sci-fi thriller starring a young Cruise.

Taylor Swift swallows a fly

Sometimes, when singing live, performers run into issues – which Swifties have long dubbed The Errors Tour.

Taylor didn’t pause her performance though, she coughed slightly during her 10-minute version of All Too Well and said: ‘I swallowed a bug, you sing.’

At a break in the chorus, she stopped and cleared her throat away from the microphone.

In time for the next lyric, Taylor returned to playing her guitar and broke into song again having got rid of the pesky bug.

This is actually the second time this has happened to the Enchanted singer as just over a year ago in Chicago the same thing happened.

During her performance of Champagne Problems in the windy city, she announced: ‘I just swallowed a bug. I’m so sorry. It’s totally fine.

‘It’s just stupid,’ she added before coughing up the creature and joking: ‘Delicious’.

Hugh Grant thanks Taylor’s ‘gigantic boyfriend’

Another day, another huge celebrity at the Eras Tour and this time it was Hugh Grant gracing the VIP tent.

‘Dear @taylorswift13,’ he wrote on X. ‘You have an incredible show, an amazing and v hospitable team and excellent if gigantic boyfriend (#tequilashots.).’

The Bridget Jones legend witnessed night two of Wembley, so missed his new friend Travis taking to the stage.

Hugh, 63, has previously attended Blackpink’s Hyde Park set in 2023, declaring he was a ‘Blink’ after that incredible gig.

The Notting Hill star could be seen at Taylor’s show munching on carrots as he danced with his wife and daughter.

Hugh added: ‘Thanks so much from one ageing London boy, wife and thrilled 8 year old #halfgirlhalfbracelet.’

Fans climb onto Wembley roof

In a more alarming turn of events, Saturday night saw three mysterious figures climb onto the stadium roof.

In Madrid, fans also saw an unknown figure dancing on the roof but this time they brought friends.

Videos shared online show obscured figures watching on quite literally from the Gods, having a little boogie as the wide-spanning setlist plays.

It’s unknown who the dedicated Swifties were, with fans hazarding a guess at the likes of Matty Healy or Joe Alwyn (who decided to head to New York for the weekend).

A statement from Wembley Stadium put fears to rest though as they shared: ‘We can confirm the individuals on the roof of Saturday night’s performance of Taylor Swift The Eras Tour were pre-approved professionals as part of the pyrotechnic team, equipped with full safety equipment.’

Those epic surprise songs ft Hayley Williams and Gracie Abrams

Any Swiftie knows the highlight of the evening is seeing what Taylor sings for the acoustic set.

Her surprise songs span anything in her discography with mashups including Edinburgh N3’s Haunted x Exile to ‘old’ tracks like Crazier from the Hannah Montana movie (yes, really).

London was treated to some incredible songs like a mashup of 1989, switching from Out of the Woods to Is It Over Now? to heartbreak anthem Clean.

Shockingly, expected tracks So Long, London and London Boy did not make it onto the set this time round – but with five more shows to go that could change.

Fans were beside themselves when Taylor sang a mega-bridge for her mashup of Hits Different and Death By a Thousand Cuts on Friday night, followed by The Black Dog and Come Back Be Here.

However, night two really kicked things into high gear as Paramore’s Hayley Williams took to the stage to sing duet Castles Crumbling on piano.

For the Speak Now track, Hayley paid homage to Taylor’s iconic purple dress and the pair couldn’t stop smiling as they performed together, having been friends for years.

However, when it came time to leave the stage, the Decode hitmaker couldn’t find her exit, running about in the dark on stage before staff helped her off – oops!

Her final night in London saw Gracie Abrams join Taylor on stage for a rendition of their new song together, Us.

Taylor shared: ‘If you know the words to this one, you get extra credit points because it’s only been out for like two days. This song is technically not one that’s mine at all, it’s my friend Gracie’s.

‘When I tell you I just love this girl so much … but when you write with someone it’s like you see the whole thing [and] all the artistry, you see who this person is really and writing with her, she’s like so badass. Like, that’s a writer.’

Released days ago, this was the first time the track was ever played live after Gracie had revealed the chaos at her house during recording which included an actual fire.

Overwhelmed? Taylor isn’t done yet as she heads to Dublin, The Netherlands, and Germany before returning to London for her final European shows.

Taylor Swift ignited a frenzy among her Swifties by bringing boyfriend Travis Kelce onstage at her Eras Tour concert on Sunday.

During her third show at London’s Wembley Stadium, the 34-year-old pop singer surprised the audience with a special performance including the NFL star, also 34.

Decked out in a tuxedo and top hat, the Kansas City Chiefs player joined Swift during her I Can Do It With a Broken Heart outfit change. The tight end beamed as he carried his girlfriend, gently placing her on a red couch at the center of the stage.

This marked the first time the duo appeared on stage together, following the official announcement of their relationship on Instagram Friday evening.

The reactions from Taylor's fans lit up social media, many in awe that Travis handled the performance like a professional, even showing off some of his signature dance moves.

'If you would’ve told me a year ago that Travis Kelce would be on stage with Taylor Swift, I wouldn’t have believed you...' wrote one follower.

Another posted, 'Did I just hallucinate or did Travis Kelce just go on stage in costume and carry Taylor and help her get changed into ICDIWABH.'

'TRAVIS KELCE DRESSING UP AS ONE OF TAYLOR’S DANCERS ON STAGE WAS NOT ON MY 2024 BINGO CARD HOLY F***,' yet another chimed in.

Still more shared their excitement, as one wrote, 'You guys realize Travis coming out on stage with Taylor in London is literally the most masterful, insane, symbolic thing ever right?'

Another summed it up nicely, sharing, 'So the 3x Super Bowl champion tight end of the Kansas City Chiefs has joined his superstar girlfriend on stage in front of Paul McCartney and 89k in London. A real sentence. Of all the timelines, this is the greatest. Long live Taylor Swift & Travis Kelce.'

The onstage surprise comes after Taylor posted an epic selfie with the NFL star, Prince William, Prince George and Princess Charlotte taken backstage.

Although the superstar couple has been romantically linked since 2023, this Instagram post marks the very first appearance of Travison Taylor's social media.

'Happy Bday M8! London shows are off to a splendid start @princeandprincessofwales,' the Cardigan singer captioned the incredible snap, referring to the future King of England's 42nd birthday.

'Are you telling me the first time Travis is posted on Taylor’s social media, it’s with Prince William, Prince George, and Princess Charlotte? THIS IS ICONIC,' wrote one follower.

Another referred to a separate selfie Prince William shared of his two kids and Taylor backstage, writing: 'the gag of it all is the fact that taylor also took a picture with prince william and his kids alone, but chose to upload the picture to her social media that includes travis.

'she’s loud and proud, and not hiding it. :’) if you told me this one year ago, i would call you crazy.'

The eagle-eyed Swifties also noticed that Travis started 'liking' several of Taylor's recent posts soon after they made their relationship Instagram official.

'the way travis just went on a liking spree on taylor’s instagram and liked 5 of her posts in a row… this man lives on the floor,' posted one amused fan.

Yet another chimed in: 'The way it's like he was waiting for her to make it "ok" by posting him is making me feel things. What a time to be alive.'

One Swiftie even posted screenshots of the posts Travis was 'liking' with the caption: 'Travis is currently liking every single post by Taylor I am crying.'

Dating rumors about the superstar couple began circulating in September 2023 when Taylor was seen at multiple Travis NFL games.

Since then, they've consistently supported each other at various public events.

Travis has been spotted at Swift's Eras Tour concerts around the globe, from Australia and Paris to Singapore and now London.

Taylor, in turn, has frequently attended Travis' games, including celebrating his victory with his team at the 2024 Super Bowl in February.

Meanwhile, Taylor also sent fans in a frenzy when she graced the stage with five surprise songs for her first London gig during her Eras Tours on Friday.

Over 90,000 Swifties packed into Wembley Stadium to see the American superstar give her all in the first of her three performances in England's capital.

And fans received quite the treat when she performed five songs in two unexpected mashups during the 'surprise segment' of the show.

Taylor performed a guitar mashup of Hits Different and Death By A thousand cuts.

She then graced her piano and performed a three-way mashup of The Black Dog into Come Back Be Here before rounding off her melody with Maroon.

The songstress had not performed The Black Dog prior to Friday and admitted to her stadium of fans that she was nervous.

The blonde beauty said: 'I have never played this song live before so pray to God.'

Her recent mashup was fitting for her London audience because the song Come Back Be here from her album Red is a nod to her London life as she name drops the capital in her lyrics.

London is the only city that she will return to twice during her Era Tours. She will later return to the venue for another five shows in August, which will serve as the conclusion of the European leg of the tour.

Elsewhere during her performance on Friday, she branded London the 'most exhilarating city in the world' amid a huge crowd of her fans.

Her performance also comes after split from Joe Alwyn.

Addressing her fans, Taylor is heard saying: 'There are eighty-eight thousand four hundred and forty-six people in this stadium.

'Thank you from the bottom of my heart. I'm thinking about how beautiful you are and just how wonderful it is thinking about the way you can spend your time in the most exhilarating city of the world.'

Before her romance with her footballer boyfriend Travis, Taylor dated actor Joe Alwyn from 2016 to 2023.

They kept their romance away from the public eye, but in typical Taylor fashion she occasionally referenced Joe in her music, despite them reportedly splitting amicably.

'Busy schedules and differing priorities' were the reasons given when they parted ways.

But now Taylor has showed the world she can both tour the world as one of the biggest popstars in the globe and manage a blossoming love life as her and Travis have before the world's most adored couple.

In a bid to keep the spark alive between the two during her busy schedule, she has reportedly coughed up for a £15,000 a week Cotswolds retreat during her London concerts.

Taylor, who is being supported by her footballer boyfriend Travis while in the UK, is believed to be residing in a luxury farmhouse estate, according to The Sun.

She is said to be a stones throw away form some the UK's biggest celebrities including Posh and Becks, Simon Cowell and Amanda Holden.

The swanky property, which is near Chipping Norton, reportedly comes with its own sizeable swimming pool and extravagant tennis court.

A source told the publication: 'Off stage, Taylor is very low key and likes her home comforts.

'She has rented a lovely place in the Cotswolds for some downtime.'

MailOnline has contacted Taylor's representatives for a comment.

Travis allegedly landed in the UK on Thursday to support the singer in time her first night of her London tour stint.

The Kelce family touched down in London for Taylor's Eras Tour concert in London, as Travis was joined by his brother Jason, his sister-in-law Kylie and his dad, Ed, at Wembley.

Travis showed up in a relaxing fit, sporting a white, Team USA Olympics cap and black polo, which matched the color of his shorts. He shook hands with Scott Swift - Taylor's dad - upon his arrival at the sold-out show.

And so did Jason, who was closely followed by Kylie, in jeans and a dark lumberjack button down shirt.

He was seen dishing out some of Taylor's tour-made friendship bracelets before the concert, as 'Swifties' were quick to snatch some off his hands.

The pop princess kicked off her London Eras Tour residency and those in the star-studded VIP tent include supermodel Cara Delevingne as well as Bridgerton darling Nicola Coughlan.

As she started her three-hour long set, Taylor Swift said: 'You're making me feel like tonight I get to play my first sold out show at Wembley Stadium on The Eras Tour!'

She added: 'There are 88.446 people in this stadium today.'

Including the leader of the Labour party Sir Kier Starmer and his wife. In a post on X he joked: ''Swift' campaign pit stop.'

Today is the first of three sold out dates at Wembley, with the international sensation returning in August to perform another five.

Taylor's adoring fans were brimming with anticipation to know if she will perform any of her London-inspired hit songs.

Among a few is London Boy from her 2019 album Lover, which is speculated to be about her ex-boyfriend of six years and British actor Joe Alwyn.

Wembley is awash with sparkling outfits, cowboy hats, gemstones and glitter today as thousands of Taylor Swift fans gathered for her opening night in London.

Swifties had travelled from across the country for the latest sell-out performance of her Eras Tour.

Teenage girls and boys were joined by mums, dads and younger siblings - and fans of all ages - ahead of the three-and-a-half hour gig, that has already blown the roofs off stadiums across Britain and Europe.

Devoted followers sang the lyrics of her many hits word-perfect that were blasted out at the Taylor Swift fan zone at the BoxPark Wembley on the Olympic Walk up to the stadium entrance.

Fans exchanged bracelets and discussed their favourite tunes ahead of the big event. Others joined long queues to buy official merchandise - t-shirts, sweat-shirts, hats and bags.

Fans have predicted that the American megstar will choose a London-themed tune as her surprise song.

Many are hoping for Swift's more melancholy hits such as 'So Long, London' and 'The Black Dog' from her recent album The Tortured Poets Department.

'The Black Dog' is largely believed to be about 1975 singer, Matty Healy, who she reportedly has a brief two week relationship with following her break-up with Alwyn.

The lyrics seemingly reference a Vauxhall pub, as well as band - The Starting Line - whose songs The 1975 have covered several times during their tour.

'So Long, London' is widely rumoured to be a goodbye song to the city as well as her ex-partner Alwyn.

During the woeful track, she sings: 'I left all I knew, you left me at the house by the Heath.

'I stopped CPR, after all it's no use. The spirit was gone, we would never come to. And I'm p****d off you let me give you all that youth for free.'

Pop megastar Taylor Swift is the most decorated, highest-selling, and outright successful musician of the 21st century. With over 30 million albums sold and 12 Grammy Awards to her name, fans everywhere resonate with her music.
Taylor is in the middle of a year-and-a-half-long Eras Tour. The tour will cross $1 billion in revenue in ticket sales. The U.S. leg alone will finish with $591 million, which passes the former all-female record set by Madonna in 2008-09. The tour's success has helped Swift's net worth reach $1.3 billion, according to Forbes.
In the middle of the tour, the rumors have turned into confirmation that Taylor Swift has found a new love interest. As the much-anticipated Eras Tour rolls on, let’s meet Taylor Swift’s boyfriend Travis Kelce.
Who is Taylor Swift's boyfriend Travis Kelce?
Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce have been fueling relationship rumors recently. Their relationship possibilities started when Kelce went to Swift's Eras Tour stop at Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City.
Ever since, people have questioned if the pair were in the beginning stages of a relationship. Since Swift was seen watching a Kansas City Chiefs game with Kelce's mother, let's look at Travis Kelce outside of his relationship with Taylor Swift.
Travis Kelce's background
Kelce was born on Oct. 5, 1989, in Westlake, Ohio. His parents are Ed and the well-known Donna Kelce. His brother is Philadelphia Eagles center Jason Kelce.
The brothers have put their stake in the entertainment world by releasing a podcast titled “New Heights with Jason and Travis Kelce.” The pair give unique takes on the football world and provide access to their lives growing up.
Some of their most popular episodes have been when Donna Kelce and Jason's wife, Kylie Kelce, have made appearances. The podcast may break viewership records if Taylor Swift appears on the show.
Travis Kelce is an All-Pro tight end for the Kansas City Chiefs. He went to school at the University of Cincinnati, where he was First-team All-Big East in 2012. The Chiefs chose Kelce in the third round of the 2013 NFL Draft. He has won two Super Bowls with the team and was an integral part of the offense.
Kelce is one of the best tight ends of all time. He is an eight-time Pro Bowler and a four-time first-team All-Pro selection. He is the NFL record holder for most seasons with 1,000 yards receiving by a tight end with seven.
Kelce also has the most receiving yards in a single season for a tight end with 1,416 in 2020. Last season, he was the fastest tight end in history to reach the 10,000 career receiving yards plateau. He was also named to the NFL 2010s All-Decade Team.
Taylor Swift, Travis Kelce's rumored relationship
The couple have been connected dating back to the end of July 2023. The Eras Tour has a ritual where the Swifties make friendship bracelets and pass them to fellow Swifties. Kelce told the world on his podcast that he made a bracelet with his phone number to give to Taylor, but the venture failed.
Two months after Kelce's claim, The Messenger put out a report that the duo had been privately seeing each other. “Taylor and Travis have been quietly hanging out,” the source said. “She saw him when she was in NYC a few weeks ago.”
The report picked up steam after Thursday Night Football when his brother said he couldn't comment on the relationship. “I don't know what's going on there,” Jason added of Travis and Swift. “I know Travis is having fun and we'll see what happens with whoever he ends up with.”
Last week, a source confirmed Swift is “having fun” with Travis Kelce as the pair continues to spend time together.” She and Travis have hung out twice, and it's nothing serious. She thinks he is very charming, and they have been texting this last week,” the insider exclusively told The Messenger.
“He is a little embarrassed at how much attention they are getting, but he has told her he would love to continue seeing her.” The source adds: “They are seeing where things go.”
Kelce finally addressed the rumors head-on, live on The Pat McAfee Show. When it comes to Swift, Travis shared, “I threw the ball in her court. I said, ‘I've seen you rock the stage in Arrowhead, you might have to come to see me rock the stage in Arrowhead and see which one's a little more lit. We'll see what happens in the near future, alright now.”
Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's first public appearance
When Kelce made the quip about Swift showing up at Arrowhead, no one believed she would show up so soon.
On Sept. 24, 2023, when the Kansas City Chiefs played against the Chicago Bears, social media erupted when Swift was in attendance. The broadcast showed Patrick Mahomes doing his ritual where he gives his wife and kid a kiss pregame on the sideline. Then the camera panned to Travis Kelce's box, where Taylor Swift and Donna Kelce were shown watching from above.
The camera panning to Taylor was a regular occurrence during the game, as she seemed to be engaged heavily in the game. The best moment was her NSFW reaction to Kelce's touchdown reception.
Swift's appearance at Chiefs games became a regular occurrence throughout the season and postseason as the Chiefs went to win the Super Bowl for the second-straight season. In August 2024, Kelce appeared on stage in Swift's concert as part of the show. Not long after, rumors of Swift possibly moving in with Kelce began circulating.
Nevertheless, this is all we know about Taylor Swift's boyfriend Travis Kelce.

Taylor Swift's romance with Kansas City Chiefs football player Travis Kelce has taken the world by storm.
The Karma singer, 34, and the athlete, 34, first sparked dating rumors in September 2023, after Swift attended a number of his games.
The pair went public with their relationship in October 2023, when they stepped out holding hands at a Saturday Night Live afterparty.
They cemented their love in January with an amorous display after the Chiefs secured their place at the Super Bowl, with Kelce heard saying 'I love you' to his pop star girlfriend for the first time.
As the power couple's romance has sparked rumors of a possible future engagement - Dailymail.com looks back at their whirlwind relationship.
JULY 8, 2023: TRAVIS KELCE ATTENDS TAYLOR SWIFT'S ERAS TOUR
Whispers of a possible romance first began circling the couple in July, when eagle-eyed fans spotted Kelce attending Swift’s Eras Tour at Arrowhead Stadium.
Arrowhead is where he plays football for the Kansas City Chiefs.
He was pictured watching the concert from a private box, and even trading friendship bracelets with fans at the venue.
JULY 26, 2023: TRAVIS SAYS HE TRIED TO GIVE TAYLOR HIS PHONE NUMBER
The NFL heartthrob revealed how he tried - and failed - to make a move on Swift at her concert.
He said he had his phone number inscribed on a bracelet, which he planned to present to the pop star.
However when he attended one of Taylor's concerts in Kansas City, he was unsuccessful in his attempts to meet her backstage.
'So she doesn't meet anybody and she doesn't - or at least she didn't want to meet me, so I took it personal,' he quipped on his podcast New Heights to his brother Jason Kelce.
He said he was 'disappointed that she doesn't talk before or after her shows because she has to save her voice for the 44 songs that she sings, so I was a little butthurt I didn't get to hand her one of the bracelets I've made for her.'
'If you're up on Taylor Swift concerts, there are friendship bracelets, and I received a bunch of them being there, but I wanted to give Taylor Swift one with my number on it.'
Although he was unable to meet with Taylor face-to-face, he had nothing but warm words for her performance, which he hailed as 'an unbelievable show.'
SEPTEMBER 14, 2023: TRAVIS' BROTHER JASON KELCE SPEAKS ABOUT RUMORS THAT TRAVIS AND TAYLOR ARE DATING
In September, Travis' brother Jason addressed the rumors about the pair dating.
'I've seen these rumors. I cannot comment,' Jason quipped while speaking with Prime's Thursday Night Football panel.
'Ever since Catching Kelce everybody's been infatuated with Travis' love life,' he added, referring to his brother's former reality dating show.
'I don’t really know what's going on there, but I know Travis is having fun and we'll see what happens with whoever he ends up with.'
SEPTEMBER 19, 2023: TRAVIS REVEALS HIS BIGGEST TURNOFFS AMID TAYLOR DATING RUMORS
While appearing on Kristin Cavallari's Let's Be Honest podcast in September, Kelce revealed his biggest turnoffs amid reports he was dating Taylor.
The two-time Super Bowl winner said 'high maintenance' would have him running for a getaway car.
'High maintenance, I'm out the door,' he said. 'If you're arrogant, snooty or just higher or above people, that's the biggest turn-off for me.'
Kelce added that he would be enchanted by 'some sort of sweetness' in a partner, explaining that his mom, Donna, is 'kind-hearted.'
The eight-time pro bowler added that he's a guarded fortress when entering into a relationship.
He said that he would look to take things slow, explaining: 'To really dive into a relationship with somebody I feel like it's going to take at least, I don't know, it's going to take some time.'
'It's not going to be immediate because, the stuff I've been through, just in my past, I feel like you really gotta know somebody to take that step and really be committed and be in full-throttle. I can't just meet somebody and just automatically think that forever is just a day away… I think it takes quite a bit of time for somebody to really get to know somebody and really get to find that affection and love for them.'
SEPTEMBER 20, 2023: TRAVIS' BROTHER JASON JOKES THE DATING RUMORS ARE '100 PERCENT TRUE'
While appearing on DeCamara & Ritchie on Audacy's SportsRadio 94 WIP, Kelce's brother Jason discussed the dating rumors once again.
This time he said they were '100% true.'
However, right afterwards he added he was 'joking.'
'It's hard to answer because I don't really know a lot about Travis' love life. I try to keep his business kind of his business, stay out of that world,' he explained.
He continued: 'Having said that, man, I think they're doing great and I think it's all 100% true, and I hope this thing goes a mile — no, I'm joking, I don't know what's happening.'
SEPTEMBER 21, 2023: TRAVIS BREAKS HIS SILENCE ON TAYLOR RUMORS AND REVEALS HE HAS INVITED HER TO WATCH HIM PLAY AN NFL GAME
After his brother's interview, Kelce set the record straight on The Pat McAfee Show, revealing that he has invited the pop superstar to watch him play a game for the Kansas City Chiefs.
'I threw it out there, I threw the ball in her court. I said, "I've seen you rock the stage in Arrowhead, you might have to come see me rock the stage in Arrowhead, and see which one's a little more lit."
'We'll see what happens in the near future.'
SEPTEMBER 24, 2023: TAYLOR ATTENDS KELCE’S KANSAS CITY CHIEFS GAME FOR THE FIRST TIME
Swift surprised fans when she showed up at Kelce's game on September 24.
She was seen watching the game from Kelce's suite alongside his mother Donna as they faced off against the Chicago Bears.
After the game, the two were seen walking out together, with Swift rocking Kansas City Chiefs gear, before leaving in his vintage convertible.
SEPTEMBER 27, 2023: TRAVIS SAYS TAYLOR 'LOOKED AMAZING' AT CHIEFS GAME AND HAILS 'BALLSY' SUPERSTAR FOR STICKING TO HER WORD AND TURNING UP
Travis heaped praise on 'ballsy' Taylor for sticking to her word and turning up at his Chiefs game - and said she 'looked amazing' in his suite.
Speaking alongside his brother Jason on their popular New Heights podcast, Travis said: 'Shout out to Taylor for pulling up. That was pretty ballsy.
'I just thought it was awesome how everyone in the suite had nothing but great things to say about her. The friends and family. She looked amazing, everybody was talking about her in a great light.'
'To see the slow motion chest bumps, to see the high fives with mom, to see how the Chiefs kingdom was all excited she was there, that s*** was absolutely hysterical, it was definitely a game I'll remember, that's for damn sure,' Travis added. 'And then we just slid off in the getaway car in the end…'
'Shout out to Taylor for coming through and seeing me rock the stage.'
OCTOBER 1, 2023: TAYLOR ATTENDS TRAVIS' GAME FOR A SECOND TIME AND BRINGS FAMOUS FRIENDS
Swift was spotted at MetLife Stadium as she cheered the Kansas City Chiefs for a second time, as they faced off against the New York Jets in New Jersey.
The Bad Blood hitmaker brought along her A-list entourage to help support her new beau, including Blake Lively, Ryan Reynolds and Sophie Turner.
OCTOBER 4, 2023: TRAVIS DISCUSSES NFL'S MEDIA COVERAGE OF HIS RELATIONSHIP WITH TAYLOR
Travis discussed the NFL's coverage of their romance on his New Heights podcast.
'Let's get to it, is the NFL overdoing it?' His brother asked.
'I think it’s fun when they show who was at the game. I think it brings a little bit more to the atmosphere, brings a little bit more to what you’re watching. But at the same time I think...'
'They're overdoing it,' Jason finished the sentence for him.
'They’re overdoing it a little bit for sure, especially my situation. [But] I think they’re just trying to have fun with it,' Travis concluded.
OCTOBER 6, 2023: KELCE'S MOM, DONNA, TALKS ABOUT HANGING OUT WITH TAYLOR

Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce have been together for over a year now and the loved-up couple continues to put on displays of gooey, sweet, and yes, sometimes cringey, affection.
Their love story has been brought under the microscope once again after a fake ‘contract’ popped up, suggesting Tayvis, both 34, might be in a PR relationship.
Swifties (the many, many millions of them) have been lapping up Taylor’s latest romantic entanglement which played out across the globe through the lens of her Eras Tour.
From belting out tunes together at the US Open to running onto the NFL field for the Kansas City Chiefs’ big win, this is an unfiltered, full-tilt Taylor Swift love story.
And while the Cruel Summer hitmaker is more in the headlines than ever before, she looks perfectly at ease with her boyfriend Travis by her side.
However, despite her clear heart eyes when she looks at him, some seem convinced this love could be treacherous — or entirely manufactured.
Anyone who saw Cats (2019) knows acting is not Taylor’s strongest suit (but we love the enthusiasm). Despite this, rumours of her carefully orchestrated relationship persist.
The Red songstress has been plagued by showmance claims from many of her relationships, but it seemed for a while she and Travis were beating the allegations.
So is it all a PR stunt, or is there something deeper here? Is Travis really ‘the 1’ for Taylor?
Let’s take it back to where it all began…
When did Taylor and Travis start dating?
Sparks first flew when the football star tried to give the Clean singer a friendship bracelet with his number on it at the Eras Tour in Los Angeles back in July, 2023.
He was unsuccessful but rumours of a bubbling romance quickly swirled as Travis made his pursuit of the 12-time Grammy winner known.
Travis and his brother made subtle nods to the relationship, building excitement before Taylor finally appeared at a Chiefs game in September, surprisingly spending time with his mum, Donna.
She kissed him on the cheek and sped off in his getaway car after games, whisked away into the sunset in his convertible like a scene from a romantic movie – fans were instantly sold on the romance.
Before long Taylor became a firm fixture at his games, chest-bumping Brittany Mahomes, looking concerned as Travis gets tackled, and wearing a golden ’87’ friendship bracelet.
Off the field, Travis was raving about Taylor with nothing but positive comments, giving tiny insights into their relationship while remaining ‘respectful’ of their personal lives.
He regularly joked about the relationship on his podcast with his brother Jason and has patiently answered Swifties’ questions on football as the fanbase becomes more invested.
Sneaky date nights and buying out entire restaurants for after-parties gripped the world’s attention before a surprise SNL appearance confirmed the romance.
Snaps of Taylor kissing him on the cheek and her iconic red lip smudged after their date night suggest these two are more than just friends.
The Taylor and Travis ‘contract’
For months, neither publicly confirmed they were dating, but coyly never denied anything when directly asked.
The pair still haven’t actually spoken about their relationship in any depth, with Taylor hard launching Travis on her Instagram in a birthday post for Prince William.
This romantic equivalent of a neon sign definitely has the hallmarks of a showmance, with the couple being so heavily promoted by everyone around them.
Not that they need to divulge any details as Travis appearing on the Eras Tour stage couldn’t be a more clear sign that the pair are totally besotted.
However, to some this felt jarring considering Taylor’s reputation for silence regarding ex-partner Joe Alwyn, having written songs about secret loves and sneaking around throughout her career.
At the end of September, HuffPost’s culture newsletter declared it a ‘clear PR stunt’ and dismissed the relationship as Travis committing to a ‘bit’ too much.
‘The only thing I’m looking forward to from Swiftce is the breakup anthem we may get soon,’ the writer added – a tired line often written about Taylor.
Taylor and Travis never addressed the claims and the furore seemed to calm down, until September 2024 when a fake ‘contract’ appeared online, seemingly written on the NFL star’s PR company paper.
It was claimed the entire romance was a hoax and the couple was due to split on September 28, with a whole announcement written out.
Full Scope PR has since denied the paperwork is real, stating the documents are ‘entirely false and fabricated and were not created, issued or authorised by this agency,’ according to the Daily Mail.
Why are people so convinced it’s a showmance? We investigate…
From Travis’ side, there’s no harm in dating a global superstar to boost your personal fame and the NFL is certainly milking the hype, as the tight-end himself admitted.
A year on and he has landed a role in Ryan Murphy’s show Grotesquerie and appeared at the US Open dripping in Gucci, which some have speculated is a brand deal.
He may just be a big fan of Gucci bucket hats but it’s likely the huge attention on them may have prompted some brands to look his way.
When they got together, the Super Bowl was on the horizon and the viewing figures and popularity boost Travis and the Chiefs have had is nothing to overlook.
The Kansas City team went on to win for a second year in a row, with Taylor rushing out onto the field to congratulate her man – an epic moment beyond romcom writers’ wildest dreams.
Taylor’s reason for a PR relationship is a little less clear-cut as she is at the top of her game right now with the Eras Tour and her albums smashing records.
Kicking off the ‘evidence’ is the second game at which Taylor appeared – Jets vs Chiefs – and confirmed this was an ongoing romance not just a one-off date.
Innocuous enough, unless you’re aware of the pesky negative press around her private jet emissions which tend to garner more attention than other celebs (even if she doesn’t top the emissions lists).
Now if you search ‘Taylor Swift’ and ‘Jets’, you’ll find adorable snaps of her loved-up, watching a football game with her besties Blake Lively, Sophie Turner, Hugh Jackman and Ryan Reynolds.
While a smart move, simply adding the word ‘private’ or ’emissions’ into that search negates any helpful PR distraction so probably not worth a whole relationship.
Fans were not keen on her rumoured romance with Matty Healy before Travis and it quickly fizzled out – with the all-American beefcake swooping in to wash away any undesirable association for Taylor.
So is Tayvis a hoax?
There’s no denying the relationship has benefitted both, but the wins are very small when the payoff is throwing her love life back into the spotlight and scrutiny.
A still lingering (misogynistic) criticism of Taylor is her relationships, with the Dear John singer often branded as a serial dater – even getting grilled on Ellen over them at 23 years old, looking visibly uncomfortable.
Those not living in Swiftland seem to forget she was in a very private relationship for over six years with British actor Joe, keeping hidden and rarely discussing each other publicly.
Meeting at the Met Gala in 2016, rumours flew as they were papped together in Nashville the following year before posting matching cacti on Instagram in 2018 which Joe said ‘wasn’t purposeful at all’.
He spent the next year dodging questions about her before attending the BAFTAs after-party together in 2019 – in one of the only public snaps of them holding hands.
In her Miss Americana documentary, Taylor revealed: ‘I felt sort of like a wounded animal lashing out. I figured I had to reset everything. I had to reconstruct an entire belief system for my own personal sanity.
‘I also was falling in love with someone who had a wonderfully normal, balanced life. We decided together we wanted our relationship to be private.’
This is a stark contrast to her very public relationship with Travis, who fans joked was letting her be ‘bejeweled’.
The Chiefs tight-end speaks respectfully of his girlfriend, without divulging endless details and seems to embrace her status as an icon and global megastar – all while grinning ear to ear.
After a year together, Taylor and Travis still appear to have good chemistry, laughing together constantly with the megastar letting her hair down more often.
Taylor even welcomed him on stage with her in Wembley for the Eras Tour – an invite that should not be taken lightly.
Most likely these two are genuinely dating and navigating their delicate new romance while also being everyone’s favourite power couple with all eyes on them.
Above all else, who cares if they are dating ‘for real’ or not – it’s their life and if fans were a little less intense in scrutinising her every move maybe they could just enjoy the love story.
Call it what you want to but Taylor and Travis could be endgame, especially if it’s not hurting their careers along the way.

Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s romance has been the talk of the town ever since the singer and football player went public with their relationship last year.
From emotional performances to subtle song lyrics, the sweethearts have given fans lots to get excited about. First came Kelce's incredible confession about the Swiftie-approved method he used to shoot his shot, then there were lots of adorable dates, including that Super Bowl kiss, and who could forget the couple’s Eras Tour antics this summer?
Not only did Kelce tour with Swift during his off-season, but he joined her onstage in London for an unforgettable performance. He’s since been spotted at several more European shows, most recently attending one of Swift’s sold-out nights in Amsterdam, where he teared up during her surprise song set. Talk about being a supportive boyfriend!
But where did it all begin for the couple whose story sounds like it’s straight from the pages of a romance book? Here's a closer look at the history of Kelce and Swift's relationship.
July 2023
On 8 July 2023, Kelce visited Kansas City’s Arrowhead Stadium, not for a Chiefs game, but to attend Swift's world-famous Eras Tour.
On his podcast "New Heights," Kelce later shared that he tried to give Swift his number via a friendship bracelet but was disappointed to learn that she doesn't talk before or after shows to save her voice. Thankfully, he got another chance to shoot his shot, as Swift was impressed by his efforts, but more on that later.
September 2023
In September, Kelce faced questions about his relationship with Swift. "I’m not gonna talk about my personal life," he told NFL+ host Andrew Siciliano.
Despite his reluctance, speculation grew when Kelce invited Swift to watch him play. She attended his game on 24 September, sitting with his mother, Donna Kelce, sparking intense media and fan interest in their relationship.
October 2023
The NFL leaned into the hype around the couple. Meanwhile, Swift and her friends, including Blake Lively and Ryan Reynolds, attended Kelce’s game against the New York Jets on 1 October.
Their relationship gained more attention when they were seen holding hands in New York City after surprising appearances on Saturday Night Live’s season 49 premiere on 14 October.
November 2023
The couple's connection was unmistakable after Kelce travelled to Buenos Aires, Argentina, for Swift's 11 November Eras Tour.
Swift changed the lyrics in "Karma" from "Karma is the guy on the screen coming straight home to me" to "Karma is the guy on the Chiefs coming straight home to me."
If that wasn't enough to melt hearts everywhere, fans also spotted Swift running into Kelce's arms after the show.
A few weeks later, Kelce opened up about his relationship while in conversation with The Wall Street Journal. He said: "Being around her, seeing how smart Taylor is, has been f*cking mind-blowing. I’m learning every day."
December 2023
In case you missed it, Taylor Swift was named Time magazine’s 2023 "Person of the Year." Naturally, Swift's interview focused on her record-breaking tour and the hard work behind her success. But she also took the opportunity to clear up speculation about the timeline of her relationship.
Swift confirmed that by the time she attended Kelce’s match in September, they were already a couple. "This all started when Travis very adorably put me on blast on his podcast, which I thought was metal as hell," she said. "We started hanging out right after that. So we actually had a significant amount of time that no one knew, which I'm grateful for because we got to get to know each other."
The Grammy Award winner added: "By the time I went to that first game, we were a couple. I think some people think that they saw our first date at that game. We would never be psychotic enough to hard launch a first date."
February 2024
Love was in the air in February and not just for Valentine’s Day. Kelce’s team made it to the Super Bowl again, and Swift was there to support him. Kelce celebrated the victory by kissing Swift on the pitch, in a moment so magical it could have been a movie.
April 2024
Swift and Kelce were spotted in the crowd at Coachella festival, where the football player lovingly wrapped his arms around his girlfriend as they enjoyed the music together.
May 2024
Kelce revealed his favourite song from Swift's album The Tortured Poets Department, released the month prior, at his second annual Kelce Jam music festival. When quizzed, he told People: "I might be a little biased to 'So High School.'" It was an unsurprising choice given the speculation the song is about him, and fans were overjoyed when he all but confirmed their suspicions.
June 2024
A selfie of Taylor, Kelce, Prince William and his two eldest children, Prince George and Princess Charlotte, was posted from her London concert, which also counted as his first Instagram-official shot on her feed.
It was a big month for the couple, as Kelce also made his Eras Tour debut at her Wembley Stadium, donning a top hat and tails for a cameo on stage with Swift.
July 2024
On his podcast, Kelce shared the excitement of his surprise debut during Swift’s show, saying, "It was such a fun, playful part of the show and the perfect time for me to go up there, just be a ham, and have some fun."
He also teased fans, suggesting it might not be the last time he joins Swift onstage - in welcome news for fans who feared Kelce wouldn't be able to attend many more Eras Tour shows once the football season gets underway. What's clear is that he will support Swift every chance he can, like when he teared up watching Swift perform in Amsterdam on 6 July.
For her surprise songs, Swift performed a medley of tracks connected to her relationship, including "So High School" and there wasn't a dry eye in the house.

Taylor Swift is officially in her WAG era. Since going public with her relationship with Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce in September 2023, Swift has embraced her status as sporty significant other by consistently showing up to support Kelce at his NFL games. And, naturally, she's been experimenting with a whole new look in the process.

As any Swiftie will know, the pop star's career has been defined by eras — there was her early cowgirl "Debut" era, her indie Tumblr-inspired "Red" era, her "Lover" girl era, her woodsy "Folklore" era, and, of course, her glittery, bejeweled "Midnights" era. With the release of her 11th studio album in April 2024, Swift found herself in her tortured poet era; however, she kind of ditches the gloomy, self-reflective vibe when she attends Kelce's games.
Instead, her WAG fashion era has been defined by team spirit, with most of her sporty looks featuring red and gold — the Chiefs' team colors. Swift has also been experimenting with incorporating vintage pieces into her game day looks, along with sentimental accessories. While some looks have been great, others have been lackluster. So, without further ado, let's dive into what we think are Swift's best and worst game day looks.

Taylor Swift got playful with sporty fashion in the best way on September 15, 2024, when she wore a vintage Kansas City Chiefs t-shirt to support her boyfriend from the stands. Instead of tucking the oversized shirt into a pair of jeans, Swift opted to wear it as a cute little mini dress.

She paired the shirt-turned-dress, which she is rumored to have purchased from Kansas City vintage store Westside Storey, with bold thigh-high black leather boots by Giuseppe Zanotti and a Louis Vuitton black shoulder bag in a look that's giving "vintage tee, brand new phone / high heels on cobblestones." She also wore a black leather jacket, an array of gold necklaces, a pair of knee-high heeled boots, and, as always, her red lip. Advertisement
As Swift fashion expert Sarah Chapelle wrote on Instagram, "Another very fun (and slightly more spicy) outfit I'd copy + paste from Taylor."
One of our least favorite Taylor Swift game-day looks has to be this absolutely giant Kansas City Chiefs puffer jacket. We get it — it's pretty chilly in Kansas in February — but a marshmallow coat with a huge "87" plastered across the chest feels like pretty overkill WAG energy, even for Swift. The coat was a creation of Kristin Juszczyk, the wife of San Francisco 49ers fullback Kyle Juszczyk. She often crafts custom NFL clothing for WAGs, including Brittany Mahomes, who wore a matching puffer coat on the same night. "An honor of a lifetime!!!!!" Juszczyk captioned an Instagram video of her making the coat.
Advertisement
The pop singer paired the custom coat with belted dark skinny jeans, a black form-fitting turtleneck top, and a fluffy white hat. During the game, she could also be seen keeping warm with a pair of red gloves.
There's nothing quite like going back to the classics — and what could be more classic than a vintage Letterman jacket. Swift wore just that on New Year's Eve 2023. Her jacket was a retro custom number designed by Jeff Hamilton. It featured a white bodice, black leather sleeves, and a number of personalized embellishments, including the Chiefs logo. Hamilton posted a carousel of images of the jacket, to which Travis Kelce replied with a series of fire and high-five emojis.

The jacket was almost identical to a jacket worn by Kelce the previous week. "This feels like a more fashion-forward way to reference Travis' style, continuing her recent 87-dubbed accessories she's worn to recent games but in a more 'his & hers' sort of way," wrote fashion expert Sarah Chapelle on Instagram. Swift paired the jacket with an all-black outfit and sported a tiny braid in her hair, which she wore down with her bangs swept to the side.
While we love to see Taylor Swift repping the vintage lifestyle on game day, this sweatshirt was not our favorite. On December 17, 2023, Swift wore a wintery look to a Chiefs game, donning the gray vintage sweatshirt featuring the Kansas City Chiefs name and logo in red and white. Although the look was on theme for game day, the gray color didn't scream Kansas City Chiefs and, at first glance, the sweatshirt looked like your average old sweatshirt.

She paired the sweatshirt with a red and white wool hat (reportedly given to her by Westside Story Vintage) and a red, white, and black plaid mini kilt skirt from Rails. She was also spotted wearing the red and gold Heirloom Ring by Mejuri.
Taylor Swift put on a festive sartorial display when she appeared on Christmas Day in 2023 to support her boyfriend Travis Kelce as he took on the Las Vegas Raiders at their stadium. She wore a thin red crew neck sweater tucked into a green plaid mini skirt by Hill House. The star of the show, however, was her custom Santa hat, which bore Kelce's number, 87, on the brim. She finished off the look with a gold pendant necklace, some delicate earrings, and her classic red lip and cat eye makeup look. She was even spotted ringing a Christmas bell in the crowd. Evidently, she was in the festive spirit!

We love how this outfit has subtle nods to both the Chiefs and to the season. It could easily transition into a cute Christmas party outfit, or, could even be worn on any average winter day. As always, the best looks are always all about the versatility.
This was one look that felt out of place at a football game and didn't seem particularly in line with the rest of her game day looks. In December 2023, Taylor Swift opted to wear a bright red wool peacoat by Stella McCartney while watching the Kansas City Chiefs play the Green Bay Packers. Many fans were convinced that Swift actually borrowed the fuzzy coat from fellow Chiefs WAG, Brittany Mahomes, who previously wore what appeared to be the same coat in November 2022. Although the coat may not have been our favorite, it did get the stamp of approval from none other than Seasame Street's Elmo, who tweeted, "Call it what you want, but Elmo thinks that coat is so gorgeous." Swift paired the coat with a black turtleneck top, a pleated skirt, and Stuart Weitzman boots. She wore her hair in a formal bun and accessorized with a gold chain necklace and dangly earrings.
One of Taylor Swift's coolest game day looks came in December 2023 when she opted for a laid back '90s vintage Kansas City Chiefs sweatshirt. This sweatshirt, with its red and black design and giant black lettering reading "Chiefs" was a little more unusual than some of the other Chiefs branded merchandise often on display in Swift's suite.

According to People, the sweatshirt was originally from Westside Storey. As Sarah Chapelle noted, it was the first vintage piece she wore. "A few weeks ago, Taylor reportedly purchased a few thousands of dollars worth of vintage Chiefs pieces from this local KC retailer," wrote the fashion expert. She paired the eye-catching sweatshirt with a few rings and her statement red lip. She wore her hair down in soft waves.
Here's yet another game day sweatshirt — however, unlike the last look, this one isn't nearly as chic or as memorable. This number was found at Ellie Mae featured the classic Chiefs red and gold colors — so much so that it's kind of giving McDonald's. Swift wore it with the sleeves rolled up and paired it with a black pleated mini skirt. She also wore a Rally House Kansas City Chiefs red t-shirt under the sweatshirt.

She also wore an array of gold jewelry, including the Cartier Juste un Clou necklace, a Foundrae bracelet, two Jacuie Aiche bracelets, and finally, a personalized "87" friendship bracelet by local designer Erimish. Swift later posed for a photo with Kelce in the oufit, when she wore the sweatshirt tied around her waist and revealed she was also wearing a pair of red and white Nike Air Force 1s.
In a rare game day fashion move, Taylor Swift wore a Kansas City Chiefs-themed jacket that was not official merchandise, but rather an on-brand jacket from one of her favorite brands. The $1,800 off-white bomber jacket from GANT featured red details such as two stars and a red floral design on the sleeve. She paired the jacket with a slouchy red knit hat and a black top. In October 2023, Taylor Swift made another appearance at Arrowhead Stadium to support Travis Kelce as the Chiefs took on the Broncos. She decided to keep her look a little more sporty and casual than usual, wearing a red windbreaker from WEAR, Fox Sports reporter Erin Andrews' brand.

Swift wore the jacket over just one shoulder to show off her black corset top by Balenciaga, which featured a front zip and a scalloped hem. She finished off the look with a pair of Prada combat boots and a silver chain necklace. This time, Swift wore her hair in a sporty ponytail.

One of Taylor Swift's best game day looks remains her very first one. On September 24, 2023, Swift appeared at Arrowhead Stadium to watch Travis Kelce play and confirm their relationship at the same time. She kept her look simple but still nodded to the Chiefs, wearing a sweet cropped white tank top from Dôen along with a pair of black jean shorts by Ksubi and a cherry red jacket with "Chiefs" printed in white on the back. Taylor Swift has arguably become the most famous and successful pop star in history, and her global smash-hit Eras Tour is still far from over.
This week, she’ll finally be starting her string of UK concerts after jetting around the United States and the rest of the world.
Her marathon three-hour set features the most iconic songs from her entire back catalogue, many of which are inspired by her real life.
From Joe Alwyn to Jake Gyllenhaal, all the way up to her current beau Travis Kelce, let’s take a look at all the famous flings that have got Taylor’s creative juices flowing over the years.
Read more: Taylor Swift's Eras Tour faces major changes ahead of star's first UK show
Joe Jonas
Taylor’s first high-profile relationship began in July 2008, and he famously ended things over the phone later that year.
Although the romance only lasted until October, Joe supposedly inspired at least three songs from her earlier career.
The tracks Forever & Always and Mr. Perfectly Fine are apparently about their breakup, the latter of which was brought back from the archives for Fearless (Taylor’s Version).
Also, her song Better Than Revenge was one of the rare times Taylor was called out by her fans, as many believed the shady lyrics “She's better known/ For the things that she does on the mattress” were slut-shaming Joe’s then-girlfriend Camilla Belle.
Taylor later admitted she was too young to realise what she was saying when she wrote the lyrics aged 18 and changed them to “He was a moth to the flame / She was holding the matches” for the rerelease.
Lucas Till
Taylor and actor Lucas dated very briefly in 2009.
Although he didn’t directly inspire any of her lyrics (that we know of) he did make an appearance in the iconic music video for You Belong With Me.

Taylor Lautner
The two Taylors didn’t let their matching names stop their romance, and the Twilight star is even married to another Taylor now, a nurse from California called Taylor Dome.
They only dated for a little while in 2009 after meeting on the set of the film Valentine’s Day, but are said to have broken up around December. Their relationship was short-lived, but Taylor L did inspire at least one of Taylor S’s most beloved tracks.
Her powerful ballad Back To December is believed to be about Taylor L, seemingly confirming their December breakup. Plus, the Twilight star actually comes across quite well in the lyrics.
There’s clearly no bad blood between the former lovers, as he later went on to appear in her music video for I Can See You and has been backflipping behind the scenes and onstage at the Eras Tour.
John Mayer
Taylor’s country star ex John Mayer has the distinction of being one of her only exes who’s actually name-checked by one of her songs, Dear John.
They only dated from December 2009 to February 2010, but the pop star still had some rather scathing words to say about him, penning “I'm shining like fireworks / All over your sad empty town”.
John went on to claim he felt “humiliated” by the diss track, which he thought was “cheap songwriting”.
While she didn’t hold back her feelings in the song itself, Taylor later encouraged fans to leave John alone when Speak Now (Taylor's Version) was released.

Jake Gyllenhaal
Hollywood star Jake Gyllenhaal enjoyed another one of Taylor’s winter whirlwinds and caused plenty of controversy in the process.
Taylor was just 19 when she dated 28-year-old Jake and their heated relationship is all over the lyrics to her 2012 album Red.
An iconic black scarf she wore on a stroll with Jake popped up in the lyrics to All Too Well, which was later accompanied by a rather scathing music video starring Sadie Sink and Dylan O’Brien for Taylor’s Version.
I Bet You Think About Me, which wasn’t released on Red until a decade later for the rerelease, takes several jabs at Jake, too, including his “silver spoon” upbringing.
Finally, Taylor’s smash-hit single We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together makes fun of the Hollywood star’s pretentious music taste, singing “You would hide away and find your piece of mind / With some indie record that's much cooler than mine”.
Harry Styles
One Direction star Harry Styles’ relationship with Taylor only lasted from November 2012 to January 2013 but it still inspired some of her most successful music to date.
He’s apparently referenced several times in her bestselling album 1989, including being all but name-checked for the track Style.
To make the allusion even more obvious, Taylor references the paper aeroplane necklaces she and Harry reportedly gifted each other. She also refers to a bad boy, James Dean-type in the lyrics.
The aeroplanes are referenced again in the song Out of the Woods, which also includes a not-so-subtle callback to their breakup as Taylor wears a blue dress that’s very similar to the one she was spotted wearing just after the split.
Finally, it’s hard to deny Taylor’s classic tune I Knew You Were Trouble, released in 2012, is about Styles, as it’s brimming with references to their dramatic few months together.
Calvin Harris
Taylor took a break from serious relationships before making things official with another fellow musician in February 2015, this time famous Scottish DJ Calvin Harris.
Her song I Forgot That You Existed is theorised to have been written about getting over her breakup with Calvin, which didn’t end on the best of terms.
Calvin went on a tirade about his pop star ex when news broke that Taylor had co-written Calvin and Rihanna’s single This Is What You Came For, writing on Twitter: “I figure if you’re happy in your new relationship you should just focus on that instead of trying to tear your ex bf down for something to do.”
By I Forgot That You Existed’s release in 2019, Taylor was clearly over it, though, as she sings: “I forgot that you existed / And I thought that it would kill me, but it didn’t / And it was no nice / So peaceful and quiet / I forgot that you existed / it isn’t love, it isn’t hate / it’s just indifference”.
Tom Hiddleston
Shortly after Taylor broke up with Calvin in May 2016 she began a relationship with Loki star Tom Hiddleston.
Many fans believed this fling was just a rebound after her more long-term situation with the DJ, and her song Getaway Car could definitely be proof of that.
In the lyrics, Taylor refers to a car speeding away from heartbreak and into safety, but it’s clear the romance wasn’t meant to last.
Joe Alwyn
Taylor’s longest relationship to date, the Shake It Off star dated actor Joe Alwyn from May 2017-April 2023.
Several songs on her albums from that time - Reputation, Lover, Folklore and Evermore - are believed to be about their six-year relationship, which was otherwise kept incredibly private.
Her track Sweet Nothing stands out as having some of the most glowing lyrics about an ex Taylor has ever written, thanking him for being a calm presence amongst the storm.
Joe is also the subject of one of Taylor’s raciest tracks, Dress, in which she sings: “Carve your name into my bedpost / Cause I don’t want you like a best friend / Only bought this dress so you could take it off”.
Sadly, this relationship was still not meant to be despite lasting more than half a decade, and news broke on April 8th last year that Taylor and Joe had run its course.
Travis Kelce
Taylor’s latest album The Tortured Poets Department released hot on the heels of her current relationship with Kansas City Chiefs’ star tight-end, Travis Kelce.
Swifties weren’t expecting her new tracks to delve into the whirlwind romance too much, as they had only been officially together for a few months by the time it had been released.
Even so, some tracks from her second batch of songs this year seem to confirm she definitely had football on the mind when she was crafting her latest pop masterpiece.
In The Alchemy, she sings: “So when I touchdown, call the amateurs and cut them from the team / Ditch the clowns, get the crown / Baby I’m the one to beat / Because the sign on your heart said it’s still reserved for me / Honestly, who are we to fight The Alchemy?”
Then, in High School, Taylor reveals just how gooey-eyed she gets around her football hunk boyfriend, singing about how she feels like a teenager again when they’re together.
“I’m watching American Pie with you on a Saturday night,” Taylor writes. “Your friends are around so be quiet / I’m trying to stifle my sighs / Cause I feel so high school every time I look at you.”
Travis hasn’t featured too heavily in Taylor’s most recent output so far, but fans are banking on him getting alluded to much more if their romance is still going strong by the time she starts work on her next album, which all signs are indicating it will be.
